text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay! I changed my shoes!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (The spare shoes are fitted properly too! ...See, they don't feel off at all.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...There's nothing strange about it...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (There's nothing at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaaaaaah!!
A desperate roar, as if trying to shake something off... Satono Diamond kicks up the turf, her fighting spirit bursting forth.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead... it's Satono Diamond!
This year's Derby Umamusume is Satono Diamond!"
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond takes 1st place!!
What a monstrous burst of late speed!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She seemed to have plenty of stamina to spare, so the Kikuka Sho should be well within reach!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My shoes... were totally fine. And yet, I... I kept worrying about them the whole time I ran...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (What a pathetic run this is...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond-san,
congratulations!
How does it feel to become a Derby Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I am truly honored to have my name etched
into the history of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Japan Derby
is the supreme honor for the Satono family as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the Satono Group must be overjoyed as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. But at the same time,
I feel I'll also be warned not to become conceited.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
My! But surely it's that ambition
that makes Satono Diamond so strong!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "That is correct. I have always been told to aim even higher than where I am now."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So, I promise that next time, I will show you a run far more magnificent than today's!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Without fail!!
(Waaaaaahhh...)

Upon entering the underground tunnel, Satono Diamond let her guard down.
In sync with a long sigh,
her natural, everyday expression returned.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go?

By the time we reached the waiting room, her expression
had shifted to one of slight dissatisfaction.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, now you're a true Derby Umamusume.
Congratulations, now you're a true Derby Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you. But...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm a Derby Umamusume...
running like that is pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
While I was running...
all I could think about were my shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it doesn't feel off at all,
you keep checking over and over that there's nothing wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Back then, I...
I shrank back from the jinx..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I let the jinx get to me and couldn't run my best race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I simply cannot forgive myself for that!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't let the jinx beat me!
Even though I swore so wholeheartedly!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...On the path to fulfilling Satono's dream,
I cannot allow even a shred of doubt to remain!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If a mighty jinx stands in my way,
then I shall cultivate the power to overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The strength to conquer any hardship!
The flawless preparation to handle anything!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: With overwhelming ability, whether it's bad luck or a jinx, I will crush it utterly!

A declaration of absolute victory, so refreshing to hear.
—I'm thoroughly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Leave the training menu to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu!
As expected of my Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to show you
a flawless race at the Kikuka Sho!

On the way back from the racetrack,
I invited Satono Diamond to a cafe.
To give her a boost of good luck as she challenges the jinx, I should treat her to some sweets.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
May I really order whatever I like...?
Umm... even a fruit parfait
with cheesecake on top...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's add triple scoops of ice cream,
put in shiratama mochi and jelly, and extra fruit...
choice_data_list: Pile on as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you put any more on top, it's going to spill over.
Thank you for the meal, Trainer♪

...And then, a familiar name drifted over
from a nearby table.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"The interim results for the Takarazuka Kinen fan vote are in!
In 1st place is Kitasan Black!!"

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Right, right! I voted for you too, so I'm super happy!

In the Takarazuka Kinen, where the runners are decided by fan vote,
Kitasan Black took 1st place in the interim results announcement.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring) was amazing! Kitasan Black got overtaken once, but fought back to take 1st place by a nose!!

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That was so thrilling, wasn't it~!
A victory won with pure, relentless guts!!"

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text: She runs with everything she's got, so you just can't help cheering for her. It's like, she's so single-minded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally!
That girl's not flashy or anything, just kinda normal.
Feels like she's one of us.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's why you end up rooting for them to win!
It feels like your own efforts are being rewarded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I think so too!
Those two over there understand
Kita-chan's strengths so well!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan... During Hatsumode,
your goal was to get more people to cheer for you, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've already achieved it.
choice_data_list: Well, you did get first place in the fan vote.
You got first place in the fan vote, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And what's more, the fans were happily
talking about Kita-chan's race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring smiles to everyone who supports me—
and I'm getting closer to that goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...We can't afford to fall behind, can we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have to become someone worthy
of running as Kita-chan's rival...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan might be running way ahead right now,
but I'll push forward on my own path and definitely catch up!
choice_data_list: All the more reason we can't afford to lose the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Kikuka Sho, which Kita-chan won last year.
I absolutely cannot afford to lose this race!
